fingerprints.story: The storm had been raging for three days, a relentless assault of salt spray and howling wind that battered the granite walls of the Blackwood Point Lighthouse. Inside the lantern room, Elias Thorne sat hunched over his workbench, the only light coming from a single, flickering oil lamp. The rhythmic *thrum-thrum-thrum* of the great Fresnel lens rotating above him was the heartbeat of the island, a sound Elias had known for forty years
